event_text: KEPCO says about 24,000 employees' data was exposed on an external webpage (the October breach)
notes: Date from Aju Press and Yonhap, relaying KEPCO.

event_text: The October count rises to 35,528 people, including retirees and partner-company staff
notes: Figures from KEPCO via a legislator's office.

event_text: A dark-web forum post claims to hold KEPCO user, supplier and bidding data
notes: Date shown on the post, per DailySecu and ZDNet Korea; timezone not known.

event_text: KEPCO says it becomes aware of the new leak, blocks outside IP access and suspends services
notes: Time from Seoul Economic Daily, relaying KEPCO.

event_text: KEPCO asks the Jeonnam provincial police to investigate, after reporting to the climate ministry and the National Intelligence Service at 9:31 AM
notes: From Seoul Economic Daily, relaying KEPCO.

event_text: KEPCO announces the leak of 1,520,248 users' data from KEPCO ON and SRM
notes: Earliest outlet we read (Electronic Times) is stamped 6:28 PM Korea time.

event_text: KEPCO posts a public apology and a KEPCO ON leak notice on its website, saying a cyber intrusion caused the leak and police were asked to investigate
notes: Both notices dated Nov 22; no time given.

event_text: KEPCO completes its filing with the Personal Information Protection Commission and notifies affected people
notes: From Seoul Economic Daily, relaying KEPCO; within the 72-hour reporting window.

event_text: KEPCO posts a separate leak notice for its SRM procurement system, saying outside illegal access on Nov 20 leaked staff and supplier data
notes: Notice dated Nov 22; no time given.
